items.html: And let us explain the difference between them. And the matter is that AA of Atzilut is a complete Partzuf in all its ten Sefirot, as is known. But AA of Beriah does not have complete ten Sefirot, only VAK alone, and it has no complete Partzuf. For since there is a screen between Atzilut and Beriah, the head of its AA is missing from Beriah, for it could not be clothed there in Beriah.
